The recommendations of the Finance Commission are ADVISORY in nature.

items: Examiners often ask if the Finance Commission recommendations are binding; they are strictly ADVISORY.
The reason for widespread acceptance of these non-binding recommendations is their reliance on objective criteria.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Recommendations made by the Finance Commission are advisory in nature.
The recommendations are not legally binding on the government.
They are generally accepted by the government because they are framed using objective criteria.
